address.missing: No public address is set for this server. An admin can set it under <c>Settings → Network</c> or on the server's edit page.
autoDownload: Project Zomboid downloads the server mods automatically through Steam when you join. Subscribing beforehand is optional (faster first join / helps with "wrong mod version" problems).
client.edition: {{edition}} — the Bedrock edition (Microsoft Store, console, phone) speaks a different protocol and cannot get in here.
client.title: What you need on your computer
client.version: Select version <c>{{version}}</c> in the launcher. Any other version cannot get in — the game then only says "Outdated client" or "Outdated server".
mods.empty: No mods active — the server runs without additional content.
mods.title: Active mods ({{n}})
pack.missing: There is no ready-made pack for the running version yet. Let an admin know — until then you can join without voice chat.
subtitle: Address, live status & mods for friends
title: Join
voice.howto: The easiest way is the Modrinth App: download it, sign in, then Create instance → Import from file and pick the pack file from here. It sets up Minecraft, the loader and the mod by itself — you do not have to copy anything into folders.
voice.intro: On this server you hear other players talk, louder the closer they are. That only works with a mod on your side — without it you can play normally, but you stay mute and hear nobody.
voice.title: Proximity chat
